verdict.rationale: An admin audit log is a fair security question for a workspace collaboration tool like Basecamp, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents an audit log or an admin activity history. Client mode (per-project visibility controls) and Everything Views (cross-project content aggregation) are adjacent features, not audit logging, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can review an admin audit log of actions taken across the workspace
